judge.voice: Hmm. The Minecraft bit was fun, I knew "Minecraft" and "play". But then the voice talked long and fast about a house and a creeper blowing up a wall, and I understood nothing, so I pressed "nevím" twice. It didn't tell me I was bad, good. Then it said I wrote a short English sentence, but I only said "hrát Minecraft", that's Czech! So I don't really believe it. A2 sounds big for me. The questions at the start were also too long, like homework. Mum could use it for a quick level, but I'd want tiny questions with dogs and Minecraft, one word answers. I'd maybe try again if it were shorter.
